notes.title: The Open Alpha has ended... But we'll be back soon
notes.notes:
And that's it for the Open Alpha, folks !  

But we will be back very soon, so make sure you "wishlist" and "follow" the game on Steam, you should hear from us before the end of the year 2024.

Also feel free to join our Discord for routine conversations 
👉 https://gmlft.co/discord-fireball

Meanwhile, we'll keep working on the game taking into account your feedbacks and most expected features... We have already some cool stuff in the pipe (spoiler alert : 🤖)

Cheers,

The Project Fireball team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2449280/Project_Fireball

notes.title: You can now play Project Fireball (again) !
notes.notes:
Project Fireball is having its first global Open alpha right now. 

[b]It has already started, it is 100% free and it will remain available only for a few days so don't wait to jump in ![/b]

[i]Please note that due to technical constraints we are not yet able to cover every countries. Available countries will be mainly in North America (+ some Central american countries), and Western and Eastern Europe. We'll be back soon for a complete Worldwide experience, we thank you for your patience.[/i]

You can't know how excited we are to see you playing our Alpha and eager to read your feedback ! 

As usual, don't forget to WISHLIST and FOLLOW the game on Steam to get the latest update. You can also join the conversation in our DISCORD Server
